entries.source: Open Terrain & Sections for the two cuts and extra contour detail.

drafts.zu: Vula i-Terrain & Sections ukuze ubone izingxenye ezimbili neminye imigqa yokuphakama.
drafts.st: Bula Terrain & Sections ho bona dikarolo tse pedi le mela e meng ya bophahamo.
drafts.ts: Pfula Terrain & Sections ku vona swiphemu swimbirhi ni milayeni yo engetela ya ku tlakuka.
drafts.ve: Vulani Terrain & Sections u vhona khethekanyo mbili na miṅwe mitalo ya vhulapfu.
